issue.description: Found 2026-10-07 confirming redaction end to end with installed bead 0.3.0 (operator: 'confirm the beads can be redacted'). Plant a secret in a description and close the bead with the secret in the close reason: the close event's checkpoint record exposes it at record.event.detail.reason, which resolve_redaction_finding cannot map back to the live events.detail field ('Not found: no current finding matches that fingerprint'). select_all_blocking_holding treats any unresolvable finding as fatal, so 'bead redact --all-blocking' refuses the whole workspace (exit 4) and nothing can be removed - in both monolithic and sharded mode. Fix: defer retained-checkpoint findings that do not resolve (they are copies of live text the batch sanitizes, and the batch publication resets the previous generation); after publication re-run the secret inventory and exit non-zero naming the count if any blocking finding remains. Acceptance: e2e with secrets in description, notes (incl. percent-encoded URI password) and close reason: one atomic batch, zero copies anywhere under .beads (db/WAL/objects/pointers), doctor 0 blocking, Git-side scanner 0 on checkpoint files, both modes; unit/integration test added; suites green.
issue.notes: Implemented deferred unresolved retained-checkpoint findings for atomic all-blocking redaction; unresolved live findings remain fail-closed. Redaction and sanitized-republish paths re-run secret diagnostics after publication, report the remaining blocking count, and fail closed on incomplete coverage. Added monolithic and sharded end-to-end coverage for secrets in description, percent-encoded URI password in notes, and close-event reason. The test verifies one epoch/revision, zero copies under .beads, zero doctor blockers, and a clean retained checkpoint scan. Merged with upstream fixes for cross-shard selector collisions and empty workspace UUID event identity. Shipped in 6a43315d (including d94a254d) and pushed to origin/main; git rev-list origin/main..HEAD is empty. Clean archive verification passed: scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast (cargo fmt --check and full cargo test), cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and the focused close-event redaction test. Initial nested archive verification failed because the repository's archive test detected the enclosing worktree; retained at /home/coding/bead-rs/.beadrs-10b5d471-committed.G87xiy. Final archive extraction passed and was removed.
